{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black straight-leg trousers, relaxed fit through the thigh, ankle length, #1a1a1a, heavy cotton twill.
Cream silk-blend blouse, classic point collar and three-quarter sleeves, hip length, #f5f0e6, smooth satin weave.
Oxford button-down shirt worn underneath, structured yoke, boxy fit to chest, #2c2c2c, crisp poplin.
Chunky gold-tone cufflinks, round face with brushed finish, #d4af37, polished brass.
Black leather ankle boots, chunky sole, pointed toe, #110f0d, smooth calfskin.

This outfit balances the rock concert's raw energy with a restrained, classic aesthetic by pairing structured tailoring like the Oxford shirt and twill trousers against soft luxury fabrics such as silk. The monochromatic base of black and cream ensures you blend seamlessly into the dim club lighting while standing out through subtle texture and refined silhouette rather than bold patterns. By opting for an ankle-length trouser paired with a slightly boxy blouse, the ensemble allows for the necessary freedom of movement required to stand comfortably in a crowded dance floor. The gold cufflinks add just enough metallic detail to honor the evening's celebratory nature without violating the request for something strictly stoic and traditional."}
